fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled truck entrance at the NW corner: the access road off US-69 pinches through a checkpoint with painted lane markings and a canopied gatehouse straddling the lanes (sat z19 entryseq/toproad).
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small white-roofed booth with a lane canopy set between inbound/outbound lanes at the gate, ~1-2 vehicle footprint, flanked by employee parking — classic staffed guard booth, not the main building.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because a physical staffed guard booth is present at the gate.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: ~2 inbound lanes estimated from gate apron width; lane stripes visible but exact split not fully resolved.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: ~2 outbound lanes estimated; mirror of inbound at the single gate.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane gate apron with ample unused paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock line along the full ~600m north face with trailers backed in, plus a dock bank on the east face — well into the 50+ band; door count ~120 is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large dedicated trailer-storage yard north of the building and a second trailer lot off the east end, both full of parked trailers without tractors.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks read as one continuous operation on the north face with an east-face extension; no clearly distinct ship vs rcv bank, so false (low confidence).
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main DC plus a small separate annex building inside the north trailer yard (sat z18 NE) — counted as 2; not a true multi-large-building campus so multipleFacilities=false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge of Tyler metro on US-69 surrounded by farmland and forest — Rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Directly on US-69 highway frontage near Tyler; cellular coverage expected adequate, so false.
